title: AttributeError: partially initialized module 'lightning_fabric' has no attribute 'strategies' (most likely due to a circular import)
author: crystalmunyee

comments.author: crystalmunyee
comments.body:
Closing this issue as it was resolved by 
1. Force reinstalling lightning and lightning-fabric and deleting the _graveyard folders.
2. Adding manual registry

import sys
import lightning.pytorch as pl

# Manually register the modules in Python's memory
sys.modules["pytorch_lightning"] = pl
sys.modules["pytorch_lightning.accelerators"] = pl.accelerators
sys.modules["pytorch_lightning.strategies"] = pl.strategies
sys.modules["pytorch_lightning.utilities"] = pl.utilities

# Import your library
from neuralforecast import NeuralForecast
